name: print-social-instagram-profile-in-hand-mockup
title: Instagram profile grid shown on a phone held over denim
whatItIs: A photo of a hand holding a phone that shows a bakery's Instagram profile. The feed is a coherent grid of cobalt-blue posts with cakes, a calendar and a fruit basket, framed by a rounded brown border on cream.
whatItMeans: It sells the whole feed as one identity; seeing it in a real hand makes the brand feel already live.
techniques: Show a social system as a full profile grid so cohesion is judged in context.
Photograph the phone in a casual lap or hand scene for realism.
Frame the image with a thin rounded border to make it a case-study tile.
Let one saturated brand colour dominate every tile in the grid.
bestFor: Brand rollouts for food and retail
Pitching a feed aesthetic to clients

vocabulary.definition: The consistent look of posts viewed together on a profile.
A presentation showing a brand's social page on a device.
A grid where posts share one dominant colour.
